newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff buys HJM in stock deal.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff buys HJM in stock deal.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc said Friday it bought New York-based HJM Consulting Inc in a stock transaction whose terms were not disclosed.
New York-based HJM, a closely held company that implements sofware to manage business data, is expected to have 1996 revenues of more than $23 million, AccuStaff said.
The company said the acquisition will be accounted for as a tax-free, pooling of interests and will be accretive to AccuStaff's 1997 earnings.
The company did not give futher details. Officials from the company would not comment further.
